newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE dollar futures rise.
newsitem.headline: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE dollar futures rise.

text.p: The Hungarian unit closed virtually unchanged against the dollar and was seen returning to the central bank's resistance level (bid) later this week.
"I don't see any reason why the forint shouldn't return (to the bid)," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The forint closed at 158.55/60 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 158.53/58 and remained some 40 pips weaker than the central bank bid.
In the currency section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), dollar futures were the main movers, rising for all maturities.
Swiss franc futures dropped for all but one maturity, the sterling, rose for three maturities.
Total turnover was a substantial 9.94 billion forints or 45,263 contracts, of which 16,000 contracts were for the sterling.
"Traders might be banking on future rises of the sterling," said Peter Janoska of the BCE.
